_comment: Option 1 on the Si arm (DECISION_LOG 14.15): the section 10 grasp point and tool orientation, but a short, slow pull -- 4 cm approach at 0.1 m/s, 2 cm retraction at 4 cm/s (the section 10 script pulled 14 cm at 0.56 m/s and tore a 12-particle strand out of the slab, 14.14). 1.0 s settle pre-roll (14.14: mean speed 0.4 mm/s by then). Units m, s, rad; jaw is the Si PER-JAW angle.
